from pathlib import Path
import collections, importlib.util
programs=Path('/home/ubuntu/continual-arc-baselines/.workbench/runs/adhoc-primeagentlearner-1790689854/attempts/71aa0823e1d7415ab0ea5a5c0e56a9c6/system/state/workspace/programs')
programs.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
source='''from collections import Counter\n\ndef transform(grid):\n    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])\n    # Marker-bearing rows are the horizontal lattice lines; marker-bearing\n    # columns on those rows are the lattice vertices.\n    rows = [r for r, row in enumerate(grid) if any(v in (7, 8) for v in row)]\n    cols = [c for c in range(w) if any(grid[r][c] in (7, 8) for r in rows)]\n    if len(rows) < 2 or len(cols) < 2:\n        return [row[:] for row in grid]\n    base = Counter(v for row in grid for v in row).most_common(1)[0][0]\n    out = []\n    for i in range(len(rows)-1):\n        line = []\n        for j in range(len(cols)-1):\n            corners = (grid[rows[i]][cols[j]], grid[rows[i]][cols[j+1]],\n                       grid[rows[i+1]][cols[j]], grid[rows[i+1]][cols[j+1]])\n            line.append(corners[0] if corners.count(corners[0]) == 4 and corners[0] in (7, 8) else base)\n        out.append(line)\n    return out\n'''
path=programs/'task-f766c90b.py'; path.write_text(source)
# reconstruct demo input
nodes=[[0,0,0,8,8],[7,7,7,8,8],[7,7,7,7,7],[0,7,7,7,7],[0,7,7,0,0]]
